ARTS ON TOUR GRANT

This grant reimburses nonprofit organizations for up to 40 percent (or up to $2,000) of the cost to hire a sample artist. Nonprofit organizations, including schools and libraries, can apply for these grants.

GENERAL OPERATING SUPPORT

These grants are designed to help fund operational costs for established nonprofit organizations with sample arts programs. The program is for local arts agencies with total incomes of $50,000 and over. GOS funding may only be spent for administrative expenses. The requested amount for these grants must be between 7 and 12 percent of income. The grant also requires some matching funds.

Arts In Education (AIE) Grants

AIE ARTS CURRICULUM PROJECT

These grants are awarded to schools and nonprofit or governmental organizations to help support sample curricula. Projects must seek to enhance arts curricula. The grant is for up to $10,000 and the 1:1 match can be 50% in-kind.
